protocol: MS-GS multi-scale: base = official -r -1 loader (full-res -> width 1600), test views at 1,2,4,8,16,32,64x (PIL bicubic from full res); ms-gs trains 1x..128x itself (dataset train split = 1x frames only). Paper tables use 1/4/16/64x; 128x not loadable (12x8 px < 11 px loader minimum).

experiments.why: paper's 3D-GS row = single-scale 3DGS 30k evaluated at every scale; gsplat on this dataset trains on the 1x frames only = same protocol. No pre-existing baseline (baseline3dgs-mipnerf360-1600-30000 has the same train images but only a 1x test split).

success_criterion: per scene and scale within +-0.5 dB of the paper PSNR; also compare our gain over gsplat with the paper's gain over its 3DGS row (calibration: gsplat 1600 garden 26.93 vs paper 3DGS 27.27, counter 29.04 vs 29.15)
resources: garden at 1600 px reaches ~4.5M Gaussians with gsplat (similar expected); RAM ~4 GB (garden) / ~6 GB (counter) of frames; put runs on /bigdata/sejain/runs with a symlink
